presets.author: Alexander Holm / Chisato Yamauchi / Hiroharu Narikawa / Jeff Learman
presets.notes: Actual Accurate6.2beta2 live-flat derivative, normalized16bit FLAC v08 layer at7roots, baked source SFZ root tuning; not latest6.2e, not full88-note individualized tuning/16layers/pedal/release implementation. Same physical YamahaC5 as original Salamander, processed variant—not a new piano model. A calibration replaces SFZ nominal level curve. Compact34key audition: selected actualroots,22050HzPCM16,max7s; notlossless/full88keys.
limitations: Compact22050Hz bandlimit; selected-root nearestpitch playback overMIDI43..76, notfull88note/velocity fidelity.

presets.name: Player Grand
presets.author: Zenph Studios / Dr. Mikhail Krishtal; FreePats / Roberto
presets.notes: Official YDP SF2 fixed-velocity lightweight browser preview; not a full dynamic engine. Compact34key audition: selected actualroots,22050HzPCM16,max7s; notlossless/full88keys.
limitations: Fixedvelocity100 only; original SF2 multiple layers are not dynamically switched.
Nominal tuning,pan,envelopes,filter reconstructed using WebAudio; not FluidSynth-bit-exact.
7s maximum held sample plus20ms fade; host key-up release.
Other modulators,CC,reverb,chorus,pedal and full SF2 release behavior not reproduced.
Compact22050Hz bandlimit; selected-root nearestpitch playback overMIDI43..76, notfull88note/velocity fidelity.
